title: OrcaResolverBridgeResponse
description: Resolver response for an Orca Design Mode capture request. Contract IDD-016 v1.0.0. Carries either a resolution or an error, never both.

schema_version.description: Bridge contract version of this response.

request_id.description: Echo of the request id. Lets the caller correlate retries and idempotent replays.

resolved_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the resolver produced this response.

version.description: State engine build version, e.g. state-engine@1.4.2.

latency_ms.description: Resolver processing time for this request.

node_live.description: Whether the requested backendDOMNodeId resolved live in the target. False on the fallback path.

target_id.description: CDP target the resolution ran against. Must equal request.page.target_id.

resolution.description: Present on success. Absent when error is present.

status.description: Frozen at resolved for v1. A response without an error always carries a usable resolution.

resolution_path.description: exact_backend_node: live backendDOMNodeId, confidence exactly 1.0. fallback_structural: node stale, matched on DOM structure and computed styles, confidence below 1.0.

confidence.description: Resolution confidence in [0,1]. Exactly 1.0 on the exact_backend_node path. Below 1.0 on fallback_structural. Below 0.5 the resolver MUST NOT return a resolution and returns ELEMENT_NOT_RESOLVABLE instead.

element_ref.description: Resolved element reference for the Action Engine. Execution addresses backend_dom_node_id. selector is a human-readable hint only.

backend_dom_node_id.description: Live backend DOM node id. Null only when the resolver could not re-obtain a node handle, which requires action_hints to be empty.

selector.description: Best-effort CSS selector hint. Not authoritative. The Action Engine MUST NOT depend on it.

ax_node_id.description: Accessibility tree node id when available.

frame_id.description: CDP frame id owning the element.

target_id.description: CDP target id owning the element.

element_type.description: Semantic element type. Drives action compatibility checks and tier priorities.

action_hints.description: Actions the resolved element supports. The Action Engine uses this to reject incompatible operations with ACTION_REJECTED.

known_bug_flags.description: Known-bug registry ids applicable to this element. Initial registry: radix_portal_block, react_props_fallback, false_positive_save.

workaround.description: Workaround instruction for the Action Engine.

applied.description: Whether the resolver applied the workaround at resolution time. Execution-time workarounds report applied=false here and are enforced by the Action Engine.

reason.description: When applied=false, why the workaround was not applied at resolution time.

fallback_match.description: Fallback-match metadata. Required and non-null when resolution_path=fallback_structural. Null on the exact path.

match_score.description: Weighted match score. Never 1.0 on the fallback path.

differences.description: Human-readable list of differences from the captured element, e.g. text or attribute drift.

candidate_count.description: Number of candidate elements scored during fallback matching.

candidate_refs.description: Selector hints for the top candidates, best first.

action_outcome.description: Present when the request carried an action. Null otherwise.

executed.description: Whether the Action Engine dispatched the action. False when rejected.

action_tier.description: Tier that executed the action. Required when executed=true.

verification.description: Verification Engine verdict. Null when the action was not executed. Success is state changed, never selector presence.

verified.description: True only when the state-diff confirms the expected change.

verdict.description: verified: state changed as expected. no_state_change: action dispatched but state identical, reported as unverified. false_positive_detected: a known false-positive pattern matched, e.g. false_positive_save. not_verified: verification could not run.

diff_summary.description: Human-readable state-diff summary, e.g. input value changed, dialog opened.

false_positive_guard.description: Known-bug id that gated the verdict, e.g. false_positive_save.

rejection.description: In-band action rejection. Present when resolution succeeded but the action was declined. Null otherwise.

error.description: Present on failure. Absent on success. Mirrors orca-resolver-error.schema.json.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. STALE_NODE, ELEMENT_NOT_RESOLVABLE, RESOLVER_TIMEOUT, ACTION_REJECTED are the four contract-mandated codes.

retryable.description: Whether an immediate retry with the same request_id can succeed.

retry_policy.description: none: do not retry, fix the cause. recapture: caller must capture a fresh element and send a new request_id. reattach: resolver attaches to the target, caller retries once. backoff: retry with the documented delay ladder.

details.description: Code-specific structured context. INVALID_REQUEST carries validation_errors. STALE_NODE and ELEMENT_NOT_RESOLVABLE carry best_candidate when one exists.

known_bug_flags.description: Known-bug registry ids relevant to the failure, when applicable.

warnings.description: Non-fatal observations, e.g. truncated capture fields, degraded caches.
